## Rationale

`orchestra idea "<title>"` takes the title as its only required argument and derives the subject by slugifying it. Capture needs to be fast, and a title is what the user has in mind. A collision fails with a message, so the user can reword the title. Area, effort, source and body are optional flags.

## Counter-argument

An explicit slug argument gives the caller a stable, chosen subject from the first moment, which matters because other records reference the subject. A derived slug can come out long or awkward, and a reworded title later cannot rename it.

payload.choice: orchestra idea takes a title argument; the subject is the slugified title
